envelope.text: `label()` returns a BORROWED `const char*` with static lifetime rather

why: upstream returns `const std::string&` into the `rcl_lifecycle_transition_t` its `Transition` owns; ours returns a BORROWED `const char*` with static lifetime, pointing at the one label table in `nros_core::lifecycle` (see `c:lifecycle_transition_label`). No allocator, nothing owned, nothing freed -- and no copy of `lifecycle_msgs`, which is the reason our `Transition` stores an id and asks rather than carrying the text. `nullptr` for an id we do not implement; upstream cannot be asked, because its `Transition` is built from a map entry that exists.
